title: Interview rules
lead: Read the rules carefully before you start. They are the same for every candidate.

items.title: Stage 1 — coding
items.body: Stage 1 is a coding task in our editor. Pasting code from outside the editor is blocked, and a large external paste ends Stage 1 immediately with a fail, without Stage 2.

items.title: What is recorded
items.body: Leaving the tab or exiting fullscreen, long inactivity and similar behaviour are recorded and shown to the employer.

items.title: Typing is recorded
items.body: Typing and editing are recorded so the employer can replay how the code was written.

items.title: Stage 2 — voice conversation
items.body: Stage 2 is a voice conversation with an AI. Long silences and other signals are recorded. The AI will ask about your own code.

items.title: Inactivity limit: 90 seconds
items.body: If you do nothing for 90 seconds (in Stage 1: no typing and no test runs), the interview ends automatically with a fail. A warning with a countdown appears at 60 seconds. If your connection drops, the timer pauses and it is not held against you.

items.title: The employer can review
items.body: If you are disqualified, the employer can review the event history and reinstate you with a comment.

accept: I have read and accept the rules
